body: The family of a man shot and killed at the mall has sued Houston's Galleria mall, its parent company and the security companies responsible for the property over his death, ABC13 reported on September 3, 2026. According to court documents cited by the station, He was killed on June 3, 2025, in a Galleria parking garage after leaving the mall with his fiancee and young child. The family alleges two men shot him after an altercation that began when the men harassed his fiancee. The Galleria is a Simon Property Group mall.

The family's attorney said the case centers on allegations that the suspects had been banned from the mall but were able to come back. Videos posted to social media appear to show the men being removed by security several times, including the day before the shooting, according to the family and its attorney. The suit alleges the Galleria and its security providers were negligent in failing to enforce their own safety policies and keep the men out, and argues they should have had a system to identify barred people and stop them from returning. "This shooting was completely preventable if they had just followed their own procedure of enforcing the ban," the attorney told ABC13.

The suit seeks more than $1 million in damages. ABC13 said it asked the public relations firm representing the Galleria and its parent company whether the suspects had been banned before the shooting and had not received a response by publication.

timeline.label: A man is fatally shot in a Galleria parking garage
ABC13 reports the family's suit against the mall, its parent company and its security companies
